constituentCommits.contract: per-sandbox capability token replaces host-wide credential on sandbox-scoped operations
pool host is backend-validated before credential-bearing adoption
pool cache is endpoint-principal-namespace bound and cached transport URLs cannot redirect credentials
command output and file transfer allocations are bounded or streamed
pool teardown follows per-host ownership, drains in-flight create, and reports cancellation failure
background process kill addresses the server-assigned opaque id rather than observational OS pid
sandbox server binary is digest-pinned, verified before execution, and protocol compatibility is checked
CLI steers secrets away from argv and corrects environment-versus-secret channel guidance

materialChanges: narrows pooled-sandbox credential authority from host-wide management capability to per-sandbox tokens for scoped calls
rejects forged or context-mismatched discovered hosts and cached transports before credentials are sent
bounds client memory exposure from runaway command output and large sandbox file transfers
makes pool ownership and teardown failure explicit instead of cancelling discovered hosts or silently losing failed-cancel state
repairs process termination semantics so successful API response cannot mask a still-running background process
replaces mutable root-executed sandbox-server bootstrap identity with a digest-addressed verified binary plus protocol gate
reduces CLI secret exposure through argv and fixes documentation that could route secrets into the environment channel
